text: Q&A backup. AI confidence scores and environmental estimates are not independent certifications.

text:
Backup slide, outside the main pitch. The public classifier is rules-based. Photo analysis and matching use external model routes with deterministic fallbacks. Pricing may use heuristics. Ledger records are hash-linked, not a decentralized blockchain. Certificates do not establish third-party regulatory certification.
